pages.text: When the old world burned after the fall of the gods, its ashes were buried by time and the shifting earth.

pages.title: Arcane Crystal
pages.text: Some call it the remains of fallen gods; others, a gift from the new world. Whatever its origin, it is useful.$(br2)Found between Y=-40 and Y=14.
A simple smelting step prepares it for finer work.
The gods once used runes to strengthen themselves and their weapons. That craft is lost, and the runes have faded.$(br2)Found between Y=0 and Y=20.
pages.title: Rune

pages.text: A rarer rune, touched by darkness.
A visitor from beyond the sky, still brimming with energy after falling to the depths. Stand back when mining it.$(br2)Extremely rare; found between Y=-44 and Y=42.
pages.title: Arcane Meteor

pages.text: A fragment left after mining an Arcane Meteor. Nothing seems able to wear it down: almost as though it were eternal.
pages.title: Stellarite Piece

pages.text: In theory, one Arcane Meteor should contain enough material for a meteor block.
